metadata.description: One plugin, agentcraft, whose areas solve foundational engineering problems in the brave new world of agentic engineering. The plugins it replaced are stubs that depend on it.

plugins.name: agentcraft
plugins.description: A dozen plugins list about eighty skills, and a job does not say which one it needs, so this is one plugin: a person types /agentcraft:start-here and is asked what they want; an agent calls one of thirteen areas by name (agent-works, agentic-teamwork, but-first-planning, code-diet, codebase-optimizer, context-doctor, docs-parity, perceptual-loop, picture-this, plugin-workbench, system-map, workflow-studio, write-like-me); and each area routes to its own procedures, read as documents that cost nothing until one is taken.

plugins.name: agent-works
plugins.description: Moved into the agentcraft plugin, which this one now only depends on: it is the agent-works area there. A person starts at /agentcraft:start-here; an agent reaches it as /agentcraft:agent-works <route>.
